summary: Pearson plc furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a UK regulatory announcement) disclosing the issuance of 21,379 ordinary shares of 25 pence each to satisfy vesting of awards under its Save for Shares Plan, issued across dates from 1 October to 31 October 2026. The shares are fungible with existing ordinary shares and were admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market under the existing block admission dated 19 January 2024. No price, stake, advisor or board recommendation is stated; the filing is a routine employee share-plan issuance, not a special situation.
